name: VA-led against other no-phase trials of the same condition, pre-registered
note: Fixed before any phrase was counted in these strata; only the stratum sizes were counted. Do not edit; additions go in a new file and are labelled exploratory. va_matched.py 0.1.0 implements it. CC BY 4.0. Made by MV2 of Munim, Inc. with AI agents.
trials: AREA[StudyType]INTERVENTIONAL AND AREA[Phase]NA, all start years
va: AREA[LeadSponsorClass]FED AND AREA[LeadSponsorName](VA OR Veteran OR Veterans)

strata_in_priority_order.substance use: "substance use" OR alcohol OR opioid OR smoking OR tobacco
strata_in_priority_order.cardiometabolic: diabetes OR "heart failure" OR hypertension OR coronary

left_out_of_every_stratum: cognitive OR dementia OR alzheimer OR "brain injury" OR stroke OR hearing OR deafness OR tinnitus OR ear OR vision OR visual OR eye OR blindness OR retina OR retinal OR macular OR glaucoma
control_rule: trend-check controls named in at least 2,000 no-phase registry trials, all years (prereg-v0.3-counts.json)
measure: Mantel-Haenszel ratio of shares (VA over other) across the five strata, Greenland-Robins 95% interval; unmatched and per-stratum ratios reported beside it
primary: HV1: the three families' matched ratios rank above the kept controls' (exact one-sided rank-sum test, alpha 0.05)
secondary: HV2: the cognitive family's matched 95% interval lies above 1
